Hand it the measurements, not the quartiles

Every box below is built from 140 raw page-load timings. The series carries those measurements and nothing else: the median, the quartiles and the whiskers are computed for you. Switch the whisker rule to see the choice it involves, because a distribution with a slow tail looks like a different story depending on where the whisker stops.
